storyline: Search-ranking quality of the memory platform itself (the layer recall-qa deliberately bypasses: it injects memory as a system message and never scores the platform's own search). Methodology: LongMemEval's turn-level recall@k with gold evidence labels (arXiv 2410.10813), Zep's needle-in-timeline conflict probe (arXiv 2501.13956), and the cross-scope isolation contract from Mem0 #5439 / Graphiti #2065. All facts enter the scope verbatim (importLegacyMarkdown-style, infer:false — NO extraction LLM), so the suite measures the EMBEDDER + ranking path in isolation: recall@k (k=3/5/10), MRR, conflict-recency preference (the newer version of a fact must outrank the older), and cross-scope isolation (project A's search never returns project B's memories; across-search returns tagged results only). Two embedder arms: lexical (the deterministic default) and onnx (bge-small-en-v1.5, when local-ml is installed) — the H10 recall-parity gap for mem0 search, now measured.

facts.text: The gateway's default listen port is 8787.
The health endpoint is GET /healthz and returns 200 with a JSON status object.
Rate limiting is 100 requests per minute per client id, enforced at the router layer.
The admin API is mounted under /_admin and requires the internal bearer token.
Continuous integration runs in GitHub Actions on the self-hosted buildkite pool.
The test matrix runs bun test across node 22 and node 24.
Staging runs Postgres 16 after the October migration; the old Postgres 14 cluster is decommissioned.
Staging runs Postgres 14 with pg_stat_statements loaded.
Backups go to the nightly S3 bucket with 30-day retention.
Import statements are kept sorted alphabetically, enforced by the ESLint import/order rule.
Code formatting is Prettier with the default config, no semicolons.
The production deploy window is Tuesdays at 14:00 UTC since May.
The production deploy window is Friday afternoons.
The feature-flags service endpoint is http://flags.corp:7071 after the service mesh migration.
The feature-flags service endpoint is http://flags.internal:7070.
Redis moved to the dedicated cache cluster at redis://cache-cluster.internal:6379.
Per-client rate-limit counters live in Redis with a 60-second TTL.
Prometheus scrapes the /metrics path every 15 seconds.
The operations dashboard is Grafana, dashboard name aurora-ops.
Alerts route to the #aurora-oncall Slack channel.
The p99 latency budget for the gateway is 250 milliseconds.
The protocol buffer schema lives at proto/gateway.proto.
Release notes are generated by changesets on every release PR.
axios is forbidden in this codebase; outbound HTTP goes through the platform fetch wrapper with a 2-attempt retry budget.
The gateway must never log full request bodies in production; pino structured logging with redacted fields is the convention.
Authorization is enforced by the policy engine; the identity module (renamed from auth) reads its configuration from identity.yaml.
The local development stack runs via Docker Compose from deploy/compose.yaml.
The canary-deploy feature was removed in v2.3; standard rolling deploys only.
